newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson Tech sees stable/strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson Tech sees stable/strong demand.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc, which makes suspension assemblies for computer disk drives, said Wednesday it expects demand to remain stable to strong through next March.
"We are seeing strong demand now and, like the rest of the industry, we expect it to remain stable to strong through March," Chief Executive Wayne Fortun told Reuters.
"It's not that we necesarily believe demand is going to go down in March, but being that it's the disk drive industry, it is hard to predict beyond that," he said.
